about.label: Background & Vision
about.title: About M. Kiruthika
about.subtitle: Bridging agricultural science and modern food technology to engineer safer, shelf-stable, and value-added consumer food innovations.
paragraphs: I am a final-year B.Tech Agricultural Engineering student at Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan University, Tiruchirappalli, graduating in 2027. My academic foundation blends strong engineering principles—fluid dynamics, heat transfer, and mechanical prototyping—with an intense specialization in post-harvest technology and food product development.

My passion is rooted in food processing and value addition: transforming perishable crops and agricultural byproducts into functional, nutrient-retaining, and sustainable products. Through hands-on college initiatives, I have spearheaded cross-functional teams in formulating an organic edible fruit-coating solution from jackfruit peel waste, developing grain-based biodegradable chewing gums, and building automated application machinery.

My career goal is to build a high-impact career in Food Industry R&D and Quality Assurance. I bring rigorous attention to regulatory compliance (FSSAI guidelines and HACCP hazard control), proven team leadership across four successful engineering projects, and a steadfast dedication to consistent quality standards.

highlights: Dairy and Food Processing Operations & Machinery
Food Safety Regulations, Standards & Hygiene Compliance
Heat & Mass Transfer in Thermal Food Preservation

projects.title: Edible Coating Solution with Automatic Applying Machine
projects.imageAlt: Edible Coating Solution and Automatic Applying Machine
projects.description: Formulated an organic, eco-friendly edible coating matrix using jackfruit peel extract and natural biopolymers to extend the post-harvest shelf life of perishable fruits. Designed, wired, and assembled an automated electromechanical dipping and spraying applicator with sensor-based conveyor timing for uniform coating thickness.

projects.title: Vertical Farming Using Waste Materials
projects.imageAlt: Vertical Farming system constructed using recycled materials
projects.description: Engineered a sustainable vertical farming tower utilizing recycled industrial PVC pipes, discarded containers, and customized drip irrigation emitters. Maximized vertical space utilization in constrained micro-climates, drastically reducing water consumption while cultivating fresh greens.

projects.title: Edible Chewing Gum
projects.imageAlt: Grain-based fully edible chewing gum formulation
projects.description: Developed an innovative 100% biodegradable, grain-based edible chewing gum formulated from natural cereal starches and plant gums, completely eliminating synthetic petrochemical polymers. Completely safe for human digestion upon accidental swallowing, delivering nutritional fortification with natural flavour retention.

projects.title: Harvesting Drone
projects.imageAlt: Harvesting drone aerodynamic and mechanical prototype schematic
projects.description: Conceptualized an autonomous quadcopter drone equipped with lightweight robotic fruit-picking grippers, precision computer vision detection, and gentle crop-collection mechanisms. Presented at an inter-college hackathon and selected for Smart India Hackathon (SIH) nomination.

experience.imageAlt: Kodai Chocolate Factory processing unit in Kodaikanal
experience.description: Completed an intensive 10-day hands-on internship in the commercial chocolate processing and confectionery manufacturing unit.
highlights: Studied cocoa bean roasting, winnowing, refining, and conching parameters for optimal viscosity and flavour.
Monitored tempering temperatures and chocolate crystallization cycles for glossy finish and snap.
Observed hygienic mould sanitization, vacuum packaging, and critical quality check protocols.

experience.imageAlt: Pastry Corner processing unit in Kodaikanal
experience.description: Completed a 7-day technical training internship within a high-volume commercial bakery and confectionery processing facility.
highlights: Analyzed dough rheology, gluten matrix development, and yeast fermentation kinetics across baked goods.
Practiced temperature-controlled proofing, baking profiles, and anti-staling storage measures.
Ensured compliance with food safety handling protocols, personal hygiene, and packaging hygiene.
